· 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 同じ中性周期8電荷、alpha=5.6、実空間像3。PME族のEssmann型SPMEであり、1993年のLagrange補間の原法とは区別します。 編集上の補足 PME族のうちBスプラインSPMEのエネルギー勾配型を採用します。格子位相の依存と有限格子の合力を測り、厳密な運動量保存や原法Lagrange PMEの再現とはしません。 採用した計算法 16³/24³/40³格子と4/6次Bスプライン、3つの平行移動位相を用います。FFT逆空間エネルギーを割当て重みで位置微分し、実空間・自己項はEwald主計算と共有します。 Fi=−∂Eh/∂riFi​=−∂Eh​/∂ri​ ∑jMp(u−j)=1,∑jMp′(u−j)=0j∑​Mp​(u−j)=1,j∑​Mp′​(u−j)=0 何と比較し、何を測るか 独立thetaエネルギー・全力との差と、共有Ewald経路自体の誤差を明記します。分配の総和・導関数総和、電荷、エネルギー差分3成分、位相間の幅、有限格子の合力と粗い格子の対照を保存します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 エネルギー勾配型では有限格子のaliasingにより合力は一般にゼロではありません。厳密な運動量保存や任意配置での同じ誤差、長時間MD、原法PME、SPME全変種の検証とはしません。 Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. SPME: mesh, interpolation order, mesh phase and conservation Compare B-spline SPME with the same independent theta reference; measure mesh/order/phase effects, charge partition, energy gradients and net force. Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Same neutral periodic eight-charge cell, alpha=5.6 and three real-space image shells. This is Essmann-style SPME in the PME family, distinct from the original 1993 Lagrange interpolation. Editorial clarification Use the energy-gradient B-spline SPME variant of the PME family. Measure mesh-phase sensitivity and finite-mesh net force; do not claim exact momentum conservation or original Lagrange-PME reproduction. Adopted numerical method Use 16³/24³/40³ meshes, orders four/six and three translations relative to the mesh. Differentiate FFT reciprocal energy through assignment weights; real/self terms share the primary Ewald implementation. Fi=−∂Eh/∂riFi​=−∂Eh​/∂ri​ ∑jMp(u−j)=1,∑jMp′(u−j)=0j∑​Mp​(u−j)=1,j∑​Mp′​(u−j)=0 References and measured quantities Report full energy/force errors against theta integration and explicitly check the shared Ewald path. Store assignment and derivative sums, charge, three finite-difference derivatives, phase spread, finite-mesh net force and a coarse-mesh control. Verification limits and failures Finite-mesh aliasing generally gives nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant. No exact momentum conservation, arbitrary-configuration error bound, long MD, original PME or every SPME variant is certified. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
